_comment: Ship gates from docs/Architecture.md SS6, as data rather than scattered asserts.
A threshold is only allowed to move in a commit that explains why. Lowering one
to make CI green is the failure mode this file exists to make visible in review.
Recorded against n=16 golden cases; recall_at_k is the SS6 number and LENS is
nowhere near it, so it is tracked as a ratchet (see retrieval_recall_at_5_floor)
rather than an aspiration that fails every build.
